answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality: it lacks trusted incoming endorsements, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify self-claims. Whether named quartz, violet, or prism, it remains below consensus thresholds until reputable, independent peers validate it over time.
